meta.title: Garden Explorers
meta.description: The fireworks rain down above the elegant garden. The Oasis celebrates as all are reunited again.

units.rawText: The day of the New Year, at the festival.
units.displayText: The day of the New Year, at the festival.

spans.text: The day of the New Year, at the festival.

units.rawText: My dear viewers, how I've missed you!
units.displayText: My dear viewers, how I've missed you!

spans.text: My dear viewers, how I've missed you!

units.rawText: What? You thought I was banned? Who do you think I am? I carry the entire streaming industry here on my back!
units.displayText: What? You thought I was banned? Who do you think I am? I carry the entire streaming industry here on my back!

spans.text: What? You thought I was banned? Who do you think I am? I carry the entire streaming industry here on my back!

units.rawText: Do you really think that such minor setbacks are enough to stop me from pursuing my passions?
units.displayText: Do you really think that such minor setbacks are enough to stop me from pursuing my passions?

spans.text: Do you really think that such minor setbacks are enough to stop me from pursuing my passions?

units.rawText: Oh, you're asking me where I'm going? To see if Jiangyu's wishes were ever realized, of course~ How about it? I know a lot of comments were asking for it before.
units.displayText: Oh, you're asking me where I'm going? To see if Jiangyu's wishes were ever realized, of course~ How about it? I know a lot of comments were asking for it before.

spans.text: Oh, you're asking me where I'm going? To see if Jiangyu's wishes were ever realized, of course~ How about it? I know a lot of comments were asking for it before.

units.rawText: Alright, we're at the spot; let's give it up for our beloved drone cameraman!
units.displayText: Alright, we're at the spot; let's give it up for our beloved drone cameraman!

spans.text: Alright, we're at the spot; let's give it up for our beloved drone cameraman!

units.rawText: As the camera pans, countless lanterns come into view. The lilting sound of a zither soon follows, and the shot gradually widens—
units.displayText: As the camera pans, countless lanterns come into view. The lilting sound of a zither soon follows, and the shot gradually widens—

spans.text: As the camera pans, countless lanterns come into view. The lilting sound of a zither soon follows, and the shot gradually widens—

units.rawText: From the beflowered stage in the center of the festival, a most melodious and pleasant music is heard. In this moment, even the wholly luminant stage surrounded by lights seemed elegant and tranquil.
units.displayText: From the beflowered stage in the center of the festival, a most melodious and pleasant music is heard. In this moment, even the wholly luminant stage surrounded by lights seemed elegant and tranquil.

spans.text: From the beflowered stage in the center of the festival, a most melodious and pleasant music is heard. In this moment, even the wholly luminant stage surrounded by lights seemed elegant and tranquil.

units.rawText: See, the stage is just where she belongs.
units.displayText: See, the stage is just where she belongs.

spans.text: See, the stage is just where she belongs.

units.rawText: Indeed. All of those idol streams, and none of them hold a candle to being there in person. Thanks, Jiangyu.
units.displayText: Indeed. All of those idol streams, and none of them hold a candle to being there in person. Thanks, Jiangyu.

spans.text: Indeed. All of those idol streams, and none of them hold a candle to being there in person. Thanks, Jiangyu.

units.rawText: I ought to be the one thanking you instead, with how much you've helped me before.
units.displayText: I ought to be the one thanking you instead, with how much you've helped me before.

spans.text: I ought to be the one thanking you instead, with how much you've helped me before.

units.rawText: I can finally do something for Sis. Seeing her in her element, playing on a stage, it... it makes me really happy.
units.displayText: I can finally do something for Sis. Seeing her in her element, playing on a stage, it... it makes me really happy.

spans.text: I can finally do something for Sis. Seeing her in her element, playing on a stage, it... it makes me really happy.

units.rawText: (...The forging of bonds with those close to one's heart is an important stage of true practice, it seems.)
units.displayText: ...The forging of bonds with those close to one's heart is an important stage of true practice, it seems.

spans.text: ...The forging of bonds with those close to one's heart is an important stage of true practice, it seems.

units.rawText: Aki glances at Daiyan upon the stage, but a wizened and gray figure appears in his neural cloud.
units.displayText: Aki glances at Daiyan upon the stage, but a wizened and gray figure appears in his neural cloud.

spans.text: Aki glances at Daiyan upon the stage, but a wizened and gray figure appears in his neural cloud.

units.rawText: (I wonder when I'll get to stand shoulder to shoulder with you again, old man?)
units.displayText: I wonder when I'll get to stand shoulder to shoulder with you again, old man?

spans.text: I wonder when I'll get to stand shoulder to shoulder with you again, old man?

units.rawText: Uwah, her performance is gonna end!
units.displayText: Uwah, her performance is gonna end!

spans.text: Uwah, her performance is gonna end!

units.rawText: What to do what to do, I haven't figured out what to say to her yet—
units.displayText: What to do what to do, I haven't figured out what to say to her yet—

spans.text: What to do what to do, I haven't figured out what to say to her yet—

units.rawText: All this planning, yet you didn't consider what to say after it's all done and fulfilled?
units.displayText: All this planning, yet you didn't consider what to say after it's all done and fulfilled?

spans.text: All this planning, yet you didn't consider what to say after it's all done and fulfilled?

units.rawText: I was occupied with figuring out how to make it all happen, okay?
units.displayText: I was occupied with figuring out how to make it all happen, okay?

spans.text: I was occupied with figuring out how to make it all happen, okay?

units.rawText: Jiangyu...
units.displayText: Jiangyu...

spans.text: Jiangyu...

units.rawText: Eh?
units.displayText: Eh?

spans.text: Eh?

units.rawText: <size=28>Speak of the devil... well, I'd have to be a dullard to insist on remaining here.</size>
units.displayText: Speak of the devil... well, I'd have to be a dullard to insist on remaining here.

spans.text: Speak of the devil... well, I'd have to be a dullard to insist on remaining here.

units.rawText: Aki smiles, silently taking his leave and giving the two space.
units.displayText: Aki smiles, silently taking his leave and giving the two space.

spans.text: Aki smiles, silently taking his leave and giving the two space.

units.rawText: You know, I... heard everything on the stream that day. Saw everything.
units.displayText: You know, I... heard everything on the stream that day. Saw everything.

spans.text: You know, I... heard everything on the stream that day. Saw everything.

units.rawText: Eh? Sis, I... I...
units.displayText: Eh? Sis, I... I...

spans.text: Eh? Sis, I... I...

units.rawText: Thank you, Jiangyu, for everything you've done for me. To me... you're also someone truly irreplaceable.
units.displayText: Thank you, Jiangyu, for everything you've done for me. To me... you're also someone truly irreplaceable.

spans.text: Thank you, Jiangyu, for everything you've done for me. To me... you're also someone truly irreplaceable.

units.rawText: Sis—
units.displayText: Sis—

spans.text: Sis—

units.rawText: I... I wanted to say the same! I want to, with you—
units.displayText: I... I wanted to say the same! I want to, with you—

spans.text: I... I wanted to say the same! I want to, with you—

units.rawText: In truth, I've wanted to take the stage with you. All the applause and praise... I'd like nothing more than to share it with you.
units.displayText: In truth, I've wanted to take the stage with you. All the applause and praise... I'd like nothing more than to share it with you.

spans.text: In truth, I've wanted to take the stage with you. All the applause and praise... I'd like nothing more than to share it with you.

units.rawText: Yeah!
units.displayText: Yeah!

spans.text: Yeah!

units.rawText: Jiangyu's sobbing disappears, submerged beneath their shared hug.
units.displayText: Jiangyu's sobbing disappears, submerged beneath their shared hug.

spans.text: Jiangyu's sobbing disappears, submerged beneath their shared hug.

units.rawText: The drone spirals upwards, taking the image of their embrace, as well as a certain someone's gratification from a distant corner, into the sky.
units.displayText: The drone spirals upwards, taking the image of their embrace, as well as a certain someone's gratification from a distant corner, into the sky.

spans.text: The drone spirals upwards, taking the image of their embrace, as well as a certain someone's gratification from a distant corner, into the sky.

units.rawText: Hehe, how about that? That raw type of emotion is bound to do well on the analytics~
units.displayText: Hehe, how about that? That raw type of emotion is bound to do well on the analytics~

spans.text: Hehe, how about that? That raw type of emotion is bound to do well on the analytics~

units.rawText: But we're not done today, oh no! We're heading to the commercial district next—
units.displayText: But we're not done today, oh no! We're heading to the commercial district next—

spans.text: But we're not done today, oh no! We're heading to the commercial district next—

units.rawText: Uwooaahhh, what the hell is this? A trap?! Why is this in the commercial district?
units.displayText: Uwooaahhh, what the hell is this? A trap?! Why is this in the commercial district?

spans.text: Uwooaahhh, what the hell is this? A trap?! Why is this in the commercial district?

units.rawText: Alongside Kuro's screeches, Florence's quiet sniggering can be heard.
units.displayText: Alongside Kuro's screeches, Florence's quiet sniggering can be heard.

spans.text: Alongside Kuro's screeches, Florence's quiet sniggering can be heard.

units.rawText: Caught already, are we? Far earlier than I expected, I must say.
units.displayText: Caught already, are we? Far earlier than I expected, I must say.

spans.text: Caught already, are we? Far earlier than I expected, I must say.

units.rawText: What is earlier than expected?
units.displayText: What is earlier than expected?

spans.text: What is earlier than expected?

units.rawText: Oh, nothing, just a bit excited. Look, I've not slacked one bit on the work I've been given~
units.displayText: Oh, nothing, just a bit excited. Look, I've not slacked one bit on the work I've been given~

spans.text: Oh, nothing, just a bit excited. Look, I've not slacked one bit on the work I've been given~

units.rawText: If anyone suddenly feels unwell here, I'll take good care of them. That should be good enough compensation for last time, hmm?
units.displayText: If anyone suddenly feels unwell here, I'll take good care of them. That should be good enough compensation for last time, hmm?

spans.text: If anyone suddenly feels unwell here, I'll take good care of them. That should be good enough compensation for last time, hmm?

units.rawText: ...Whatever, it'll do. I'm off to where Croque is, and you should take care, too.
units.displayText: ...Whatever, it'll do. I'm off to where Croque is, and you should take care, too.

spans.text: ...Whatever, it'll do. I'm off to where Croque is, and you should take care, too.

units.rawText: Whoa! It feels kinda embarrassing when someone dotes upon you this much. See you~
units.displayText: Whoa! It feels kinda embarrassing when someone dotes upon you this much. See you~

spans.text: Whoa! It feels kinda embarrassing when someone dotes upon you this much. See you~

units.rawText: Stepping away from Florence's first aid window, Horizon pulls out her terminal, making final confirmations.
units.displayText: Stepping away from Florence's first aid window, Horizon pulls out her terminal, making final confirmations.

spans.text: Stepping away from Florence's first aid window, Horizon pulls out her terminal, making final confirmations.

units.rawText: Horizon, Sakuya, anything out of the ordinary? I'm more or less done here, and the system maintenance has pretty much come to a close, too.
units.displayText: Horizon, Sakuya, anything out of the ordinary? I'm more or less done here, and the system maintenance has pretty much come to a close, too.

spans.text: Horizon, Sakuya, anything out of the ordinary? I'm more or less done here, and the system maintenance has pretty much come to a close, too.

units.rawText: I've made the rounds on my side as well, everything's fine.
units.displayText: I've made the rounds on my side as well, everything's fine.

spans.text: I've made the rounds on my side as well, everything's fine.

units.rawText: Maintenance on the greenery display has gone smoothly, too. If there is nothing else that requires our attention, I think we're more or less done for the day.
units.displayText: Maintenance on the greenery display has gone smoothly, too. If there is nothing else that requires our attention, I think we're more or less done for the day.

spans.text: Maintenance on the greenery display has gone smoothly, too. If there is nothing else that requires our attention, I think we're more or less done for the day.

units.rawText: I did arrange for a visit to the wishing lamps with Daiyan.
units.displayText: I did arrange for a visit to the wishing lamps with Daiyan.

spans.text: I did arrange for a visit to the wishing lamps with Daiyan.

units.rawText: Well... is the little prank Florence pulled worth mentioning...
units.displayText: Well... is the little prank Florence pulled worth mentioning...

spans.text: Well... is the little prank Florence pulled worth mentioning...

units.rawText: Hm? The trap she erected? It doesn't seem to be capable of causing any real damage, and it only targets select Dolls, so I simply overlooked it.
units.displayText: Hm? The trap she erected? It doesn't seem to be capable of causing any real damage, and it only targets select Dolls, so I simply overlooked it.

spans.text: Hm? The trap she erected? It doesn't seem to be capable of causing any real damage, and it only targets select Dolls, so I simply overlooked it.

units.rawText: No, I think what Croque meant is... you've forgotten her that easily?
units.displayText: No, I think what Croque meant is... you've forgotten her that easily?

spans.text: No, I think what Croque meant is... you've forgotten her that easily?

units.rawText: And to allow her to work at the festival... aren't you giving her exactly what she wants?
units.displayText: And to allow her to work at the festival... aren't you giving her exactly what she wants?

spans.text: And to allow her to work at the festival... aren't you giving her exactly what she wants?

units.rawText: But she's been genuinely helpful. There are very few medical personnel willing to staff the festival.
units.displayText: But she's been genuinely helpful. There are very few medical personnel willing to staff the festival.

spans.text: But she's been genuinely helpful. There are very few medical personnel willing to staff the festival.

units.rawText: Sigh, Horizon, you're... too nice for your own good.
units.displayText: Sigh, Horizon, you're... too nice for your own good.

spans.text: Sigh, Horizon, you're... too nice for your own good.

units.rawText: Well, that's Horizon for you. Thank you all for your work recently.
units.displayText: Well, that's Horizon for you. Thank you all for your work recently.

spans.text: Well, that's Horizon for you. Thank you all for your work recently.

units.rawText: Good work, everyone. Seeing so many happy faces at the festival is reward enough.
units.displayText: Good work, everyone. Seeing so many happy faces at the festival is reward enough.

spans.text: Good work, everyone. Seeing so many happy faces at the festival is reward enough.

units.rawText: It might be a bit late for this, but I should say it regardless—
units.displayText: It might be a bit late for this, but I should say it regardless—

spans.text: It might be a bit late for this, but I should say it regardless—

units.rawText: Happy New Year!
units.displayText: Happy New Year!

spans.text: Happy New Year!

units.rawText: The three in the call burst into laughter.
units.displayText: The three in the call burst into laughter.

spans.text: The three in the call burst into laughter.

units.rawText: Finishing her shift at the first aid window, Florence has no difficulty finding Kuro, still trapped.
units.displayText: Finishing her shift at the first aid window, Florence has no difficulty finding Kuro, still trapped.

spans.text: Finishing her shift at the first aid window, Florence has no difficulty finding Kuro, still trapped.

units.rawText: Well well, if it isn't the great sage Kuro? Did you not foresee your miserable portents today?
units.displayText: Well well, if it isn't the great sage Kuro? Did you not foresee your miserable portents today?

spans.text: Well well, if it isn't the great sage Kuro? Did you not foresee your miserable portents today?

units.rawText: Blegh, cut it with that stuff on an occasion like this!
units.displayText: Blegh, cut it with that stuff on an occasion like this!

spans.text: Blegh, cut it with that stuff on an occasion like this!

units.rawText: I just figured that I might as well keep up the fortune-teller deal for a bit. The green creature's allowed to take my spot, but I'm not allowed to pull an imitation of it?
units.displayText: I just figured that I might as well keep up the fortune-teller deal for a bit. The green creature's allowed to take my spot, but I'm not allowed to pull an imitation of it?

spans.text: I just figured that I might as well keep up the fortune-teller deal for a bit. The green creature's allowed to take my spot, but I'm not allowed to pull an imitation of it?

units.rawText: Hmph, just you wait until I get streaming again~ I baited two idiots last time, and I'll have no trouble doing it again.
units.displayText: Hmph, just you wait until I get streaming again~ I baited two idiots last time, and I'll have no trouble doing it again.

spans.text: Hmph, just you wait until I get streaming again~ I baited two idiots last time, and I'll have no trouble doing it again.

units.rawText: Hey, Sis, look at this one!
units.displayText: Hey, Sis, look at this one!

spans.text: Hey, Sis, look at this one!

units.rawText: Hehe, don't be so hasty. Make sure you don't rub off the letters you just wrote.
units.displayText: Hehe, don't be so hasty. Make sure you don't rub off the letters you just wrote.

spans.text: Hehe, don't be so hasty. Make sure you don't rub off the letters you just wrote.

units.rawText: Oh? Seems we have some familiar faces.
units.displayText: Oh? Seems we have some familiar faces.

spans.text: Oh? Seems we have some familiar faces.

units.rawText: Hi hi~ might I ask if any of you lovely people would be willing to have a wander with me, and see what there is to see?
units.displayText: Hi hi~ might I ask if any of you lovely people would be willing to have a wander with me, and see what there is to see?

spans.text: Hi hi~ might I ask if any of you lovely people would be willing to have a wander with me, and see what there is to see?

units.rawText: Oh? It's Florence.
units.displayText: Oh? It's Florence.

spans.text: Oh? It's Florence.

units.rawText: Great timing! Look, Sis wrote this!
units.displayText: Great timing! Look, Sis wrote this!

spans.text: Great timing! Look, Sis wrote this!

units.rawText: <size=28>When did you two get this chummy? Uhm, is this the shonen "don't know 'em till you fight 'em" archetype?</size>
units.displayText: When did you two get this chummy? Uhm, is this the shonen "don't know 'em till you fight 'em" archetype?

spans.text: When did you two get this chummy? Uhm, is this the shonen "don't know 'em till you fight 'em" archetype?

units.rawText: I'm here to have a look at the flower lamps Sakuya recommended... wow, lotta stalls here, actually.
units.displayText: I'm here to have a look at the flower lamps Sakuya recommended... wow, lotta stalls here, actually.

spans.text: I'm here to have a look at the flower lamps Sakuya recommended... wow, lotta stalls here, actually.

units.rawText: And over there is... divination?
units.displayText: And over there is... divination?

spans.text: And over there is... divination?

units.rawText: On the first day of the New Year, it is indeed a fine time for some augury.
units.displayText: On the first day of the New Year, it is indeed a fine time for some augury.

spans.text: On the first day of the New Year, it is indeed a fine time for some augury.

units.rawText: Wow, we're getting business already? I think I'd better put on nothing but the best for our old friends.
units.displayText: Wow, we're getting business already? I think I'd better put on nothing but the best for our old friends.

spans.text: Wow, we're getting business already? I think I'd better put on nothing but the best for our old friends.

units.rawText: Beneath the New Year's lights, everyone found themselves submerged in the bustling atmosphere.
units.displayText: Beneath the New Year's lights, everyone found themselves submerged in the bustling atmosphere.

spans.text: Beneath the New Year's lights, everyone found themselves submerged in the bustling atmosphere.

units.rawText: Come, one and all, have a look~
units.displayText: Come, one and all, have a look~

spans.text: Come, one and all, have a look~

units.rawText: It's... Kuro?
units.displayText: It's... Kuro?

spans.text: It's... Kuro?

units.rawText: Cough cough! I'll have you know that I'm the one and only great sage, Kuro!
units.displayText: Cough cough! I'll have you know that I'm the one and only great sage, Kuro!

spans.text: Cough cough! I'll have you know that I'm the one and only great sage, Kuro!

units.rawText: How about it, Sir and Madams? A spot of fortune-telling, maybe?
units.displayText: How about it, Sir and Madams? A spot of fortune-telling, maybe?

spans.text: How about it, Sir and Madams? A spot of fortune-telling, maybe?

units.rawText: Let's have a go, shall we? She was pretty on-point with me and Jiangyu last time.
units.displayText: Let's have a go, shall we? She was pretty on-point with me and Jiangyu last time.

spans.text: Let's have a go, shall we? She was pretty on-point with me and Jiangyu last time.

units.rawText: No, wait, wasn't she in cahoots with Florence back then?
units.displayText: No, wait, wasn't she in cahoots with Florence back then?

spans.text: No, wait, wasn't she in cahoots with Florence back then?

units.rawText: Look, ok, there's no funny business this time around. Now, I'm... I'm a reformed, goodly businessperson!
units.displayText: Look, ok, there's no funny business this time around. Now, I'm... I'm a reformed, goodly businessperson!

spans.text: Look, ok, there's no funny business this time around. Now, I'm... I'm a reformed, goodly businessperson!

units.rawText: Hmph...
units.displayText: Hmph...

spans.text: Hmph...

units.rawText: Well, I suppose it can't hurt.
units.displayText: Well, I suppose it can't hurt.

spans.text: Well, I suppose it can't hurt.

units.rawText: Florence, look here! Sis wrote this one, too!
units.displayText: Florence, look here! Sis wrote this one, too!

spans.text: Florence, look here! Sis wrote this one, too!

units.rawText: Okay, okay, I'm not blind.
units.displayText: Okay, okay, I'm not blind.

spans.text: Okay, okay, I'm not blind.

units.rawText: Speaking of it, are your wounds fully healed? Will you need another session of intensive care?
units.displayText: Speaking of it, are your wounds fully healed? Will you need another session of intensive care?

spans.text: Speaking of it, are your wounds fully healed? Will you need another session of intensive care?

units.rawText: That won't be necessary! It sure did the job, but I'd really prefer not going through it again!
units.displayText: That won't be necessary! It sure did the job, but I'd really prefer not going through it again!

spans.text: That won't be necessary! It sure did the job, but I'd really prefer not going through it again!

units.rawText: Hehe, she's made fast friends with those at the Medical Department, I see.
units.displayText: Hehe, she's made fast friends with those at the Medical Department, I see.

spans.text: Hehe, she's made fast friends with those at the Medical Department, I see.

units.rawText: Yeah, after dealing with the Beast-Mecha "Nian" and being treated by Florence, they got along pretty quickly.
units.displayText: Yeah, after dealing with the Beast-Mecha "Nian" and being treated by Florence, they got along pretty quickly.

spans.text: Yeah, after dealing with the Beast-Mecha "Nian" and being treated by Florence, they got along pretty quickly.

units.rawText: Frankly, it was all a bit too fast, almost. But it is that forgiving side of her that allows her to make such good friends here in such a short time.
units.displayText: Frankly, it was all a bit too fast, almost. But it is that forgiving side of her that allows her to make such good friends here in such a short time.

spans.text: Frankly, it was all a bit too fast, almost. But it is that forgiving side of her that allows her to make such good friends here in such a short time.

units.rawText: Hahaha... amazing, truly.
units.displayText: Hahaha... amazing, truly.

spans.text: Hahaha... amazing, truly.

units.rawText: Sakuya gazes into the night sky, sprinkled with the occasional firework, a beautiful contrast to the festival's warm lights.
units.displayText: Sakuya gazes into the night sky, sprinkled with the occasional firework, a beautiful contrast to the festival's warm lights.

spans.text: Sakuya gazes into the night sky, sprinkled with the occasional firework, a beautiful contrast to the festival's warm lights.

units.rawText: <color=orange>Another unforgettable New Year, it would seem.</color>
units.displayText: Another unforgettable New Year, it would seem.

spans.text: Another unforgettable New Year, it would seem.
